subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace `SKILL.md` diagnostics be resolved by a new `skills lint` command first, or must normal `skills list`, `skills check`, gateway status, and Web UI also show skipped-candidate warnings before this issue is considered fixed?
rationale: Current main still lacks diagnostics, and the open PR is plausible but intentionally narrower than the full issue text; automation should not choose the permanent user-visible diagnostic surface without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land lint-first after repair
options.body: Fix the open PR's symlink parity gap, land `skills lint` plus docs as the first supported diagnostic surface, and leave broader status/Web visibility as explicit follow-up if desired.

options.title: Require full status/UI visibility
options.body: Keep the issue open until skipped-candidate diagnostics are threaded into gateway status, CLI list/check, and the Web skills view, not only a separate lint command.

options.title: Narrow the issue to CLI validation
options.body: Retitle or clarify the issue so the accepted solution is a local validation command and docs, avoiding an implied requirement for normal status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Land lint-first after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the open PR's symlink parity gap, land `skills lint` plus docs as the first supported diagnostic surface, and leave broader status/Web visibility as explicit follow-up if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans CLI UX, docs, and frontmatter parsing surfaces where this history is strongest.
